title_zh: 帮助新生明确校园求助问题

scenario.label_zh: 帮助新生明确校园求助问题
scenario.goal_zh: 回应新生对不了解校园流程的顾虑，并确定向服务台询问辅导课预约方式

context_zh: 大学新生与学生导师谈话；新生刚从另一国家来到学校，还不了解校园预约系统。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Mateo
sentences.text: I'm a freshman, and I still can't work out how to book a tutoring session.

sentences.speaker: Wendy
sentences.text: The student help desk can give you guidance. Have you tried them?

sentences.speaker: Mateo
sentences.text: No. I'm worried that my ignorance of the system will make me look unprepared.

sentences.speaker: Wendy
sentences.text: Not knowing a new system is normal. What exactly would you like to ask?

sentences.speaker: Mateo
sentences.text: Where the booking page is, and whether I can choose a time. Will it be different because I am a foreigner?

sentences.speaker: Wendy
sentences.text: The desk can check your access, but being from another country is not a reason to avoid asking.

sentences.speaker: Mateo
sentences.text: All right. I'll ask them to show me the booking page and explain the available times.
